integrity: Analytic proof with 131 deterministic finite-law checks; primary source mean capacities and classical extreme-value ingredients acknowledged. Reproducibility code packaged. No external or independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Independent symmetric Poisson counts; ideal complete local reactions; one non-destructively selected pair; no selection/measurement cost; fixed-loading and strictly sequential Gaussian-then-extreme asymptotic regimes only. No simultaneous triangular-array or experimental-kinetics result.
title: Extreme-value laws for adaptively selected two-compartment fusion
